stimuli.title: Seven people live on different floors of a seven-storey building. Floor 1 is the bottom floor, and floor 7 is the top floor.
stimuli.body:
Clues:
1. Aarav is exactly 2 positions above Shreya.
2. Bhavna is at floor 4.
3. Ira is exactly 3 positions above Zoya.
4. There are exactly 1 positions between Zoya and Farhan.
stimuli.solution: floor 1: Farhan; floor 2: Jatin; floor 3: Zoya; floor 4: Bhavna; floor 5: Shreya; floor 6: Ira; floor 7: Aarav

stimuli.title: Seven people have interviews in seven consecutive months from January to July, one per month.
stimuli.body:

stimuli.title: Seven employees hold seven distinct ranks (rank 1 is junior-most and rank 7 is senior-most).

stimuli.title: In a certain coded language, each word has one unique code.
stimuli.body:
thunder breeze bridge = ve sa bi

questions.stem: Ritu walks 85 km north, then 68 km east, then 17 km south and finally 17 km west. What is her shortest distance from the starting point?
